text.tspan: Service identities, listener addresses, and ports
Host / workload opt-out; host-network / external excluded
App unit binding / Dedicated worker accounts
Delegated cgroups + per-worker budgets + minimal root
Internet route from unique internet-proxy egress
Nix reads local listener addresses and identities without resolving egress.
Endpoint selection stays fixed until configuration changes.
